River of Lights.alt: Palm trees and downtown Tampa towers at dusk, photographed from Curtis Hixon Park
River of Lights.caption: Curtis Hixon Park on the Hillsborough River in downtown Tampa at dusk, April 2013. The photo shows the park and skyline, not the River of Lights cruise.
River of Lights.author: Michelle Maria
River of Lights.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to JPEG. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
River of Lights.verification: Wikimedia Commons file "Curtis Hixon Park Tampa Florida United States - panoramio (1).jpg" by Michelle Maria, taken 2013-04-06, titled as Curtis Hixon Park in Tampa. Live Commons licence checked 2026-11-23: CC BY 3.0. Viewed the original 2507x1582 photograph: palms and downtown Tampa towers at dusk from the park on the Hillsborough River, the setting for the cruise, not the cruise itself. A different river-night photograph (Dennis Ludlow, File:Tampa_night.jpg) is reserved so this pick is not a near duplicate of the unmerged PR 2700 River of Lights hero.
